title: KBDocument
description: Canonical structured representation of one Knowledge Base article (policy, FAQ, or SOP). This is a DERIVED INDEX, mechanically regenerated by an extraction pipeline from the authored source file (classical HTML-body, PDF, or TXT) on every publish/update — it is never a second thing an author edits or keeps in sync by hand. No field here is hand-authored or hand-tagged.

doc_id.description: Stable ID. Source: CMS content ID (already exists).

doc_type.description: Source: CMS content-type field (already exists — this is just which template the author picked).

title.description: Source: CMS title field, or PDF/TXT filename/title metadata.

source_url.description: Canonical location of the AUTHORED source file (HTML page, PDF, or TXT). Milvus/graph never store the source itself — they point back here.

source_format.description: Which format adapter produced this index. Determines how much structural signal was available (see block_source) and what source_ref means at the block level.

ocr_applied.description: True if text extraction required OCR (scanned/image-based PDF). Any document with ocr_applied=true carrying a dollar_threshold or time_window entity is auto-routed to human review regardless of classifier confidence — OCR misreads on numbers are policy-accuracy bugs, not search bugs.

ocr_confidence.description: OCR engine's own confidence score, when ocr_applied is true.

category.description: Taxonomy path, e.g. ["Returns", "Electronics"]. Source: CMS category/taxonomy picker (already exists in publish workflow).

audience.description: Source: CMS 'who is this for' field, or inferred from doc_type + category if not explicitly set.

channel.description: Source: CMS channel-applicability field (already exists for most policy content).

region.description: Jurisdiction/region codes, or ["GLOBAL"]. Source: CMS localization/region field.

governance.description: All fields here already exist in the standard publish/approval workflow — reused, not new.

supersedes.description: doc_id of prior version. Source: CMS version history, mapped automatically.

sensitivity.description: Restricted = human-in-the-loop or gated agent tier only.

blocks.description: Ordered content blocks. Source: (a) the structured component the author inserted while writing (Steps, Eligibility, Exception, Q&A, etc. — zero extra effort, it's just normal editing), or (b) for legacy freeform rich text, auto-classified by the enrichment pipeline.

entities.description: Structured facts extracted automatically from block text — powers scalar/hybrid filtering in Milvus and rule-based agent reasoning instead of re-parsing prose. 100% pipeline-derived.

relations.description: Edges for the knowledge graph. Source is tracked per-edge so structural/derived edges (high trust) are distinguishable from LLM-inferred ones (reviewed at low confidence).

order.description: Sequence within document; required so step order is never lost in an SOP.

parent_block_id.description: e.g. a 'step' block's parent is its 'procedure_steps' block.

heading_path.description: Breadcrumb, e.g. ["Returns Policy","Electronics","Eligibility"]. Prepended to embedded text for retrieval context.

text.description: Clean text ONLY — HTML stripped, entities decoded, tables/lists converted to plain structured text. This is what gets embedded in Milvus. Never used for display.

html.description: Formatted fragment for THIS block. For source_format=html: the original div/header/bold/list/table markup, sanitized only for safety (scripts, event handlers, tracking attrs stripped). For source_format=pdf/txt: best-effort reconstructed markup from layout heuristics (may be low-fidelity, e.g. just wrapped inferred lists/headings). Used to render citations and agent-facing answers with formatting intact. Never embedded, never indexed for search.

block_source.description: How this block's type/boundaries were determined, since none of the three source formats hand over pre-tagged blocks: html_heuristic = DOM tag structure + LLM fallback for ambiguous freeform markup; pdf_layout = font size/weight, indentation, bounding-box grouping + LLM; plaintext_pattern = regex/LLM only, weakest structural signal — route to review more aggressively by default.

source_ref.description: Provenance pointer back to the exact location in the authored source, for citation and traceability. Populate whichever fields apply to source_format; leave the rest null.

bbox.description: PDF only: [x0, y0, x1, y1] bounding box on the page.

subject.description: doc_id or block_id. Defaults to this document if omitted.

object.description: Target doc_id, block_id, or entity value.

source.description: cms_structural = version history/taxonomy (trusted); component_derived = block nesting (trusted); llm_inferred = semantic inference (needs confidence + review for low scores).
